notes.key_messages:
Candidates are reminded to ensure that they have met all the demands of each question. It is essential that
they check they have given their answer in the correct form, whether exact or to 3 significant figures as per
the rubric. Particular notice should be taken of the word ‘Hence’. This is an instruction for the candidate to
use work or an answer from the previous part in the question. Alternative methods are not acceptable unless
the question states ‘Hence, or otherwise’.
notes.general_comments:
It was evident that many candidates had either not prepared well or had not covered the complete syllabus.
For example, many candidates did not appear to have studied circular measure. Many candidates showed a
poor grasp of algebra, or did not take sufficient care with their algebraic working. Timing did not appear to be
an issue and candidates had enough space in which to answer the questions.
